pairs.note:
1:14 p.m. Weather conditions: air temperature 67 degrees, relative humidity 50 percent, barometer 30.33 inches, adjusted altitude 1,019 feet.

John Hall’s 6.735-second run was his quickest qualifying pass at this event. 

Steve Johnson first competed at this event in 1987 and is the only Pro driver from that race who is still competing as a driver.

Hall is 3 - 2 against Johnson in prior events. 

Johnson gets out of the gate first and goes down the groove with a career best ET to take the win. Hall made a decent pass but was falling behind all the way through the run.

Angie Smith wins 74% of her Round 1 races when she has lane choice. 

This is Chris Bostick’s fourth race this year, and he has raced a member of the Smith family in each of his three previous races.

Smith is 7 - 3 against Bostick in prior events. 

Bostick gets the holeshot, stays in front past the 330 foot mark, then Smith is able to reel him in and pull away for the win.

Angie Smith's incremental margins (negative if behind): 60ft(-0.046), 330 ft(-0.028), 660ft(0.015), 1,000ft(0.069).  MOV: 0.1430 seconds (approximately 38 feet).

Ryan Oehler is 3–2 in Round 1 when qualifying No. 7. 

The 6.753-second run Clayton Howey recorded in qualifying is the quickest of his career.

Howey is 2 - 0 against Oehler in prior events. 

Howey gets out of the gate first but Oehler reels him in just past the 1000 foot mark and takes the win.

Ryan Oehler's incremental margins (negative if behind): 60ft(-0.041), 330 ft(-0.030), 660ft(-0.014), 1,000ft(-0.003).  MOV: 0.0070 seconds (approximately 2 feet).

Chase Van Sant’s 6.718-second qualifying run is a career best. Geno Scali is 84–82 in Round 1.

Van Sant gets the holeshot and extends his lead all the way through the run.

Chase Van Sant's incremental margins: 60ft(0.057), 330 ft(0.067), 660ft(0.068), 1,000ft(0.071).  MOV: 0.0730 seconds (approximately 21 feet).

Richard Gadson has won 29 rounds this year after winning 34 rounds during the entire 2025 season. 

Marc Ingwersen is making his 77th career start.

Gadson and Ingwersen have each won 1 times against the other in prior events. 

Ingwersen gets the advantage off of the line but Gadson rode around him before they reached the 60 foot mark and pulled away for the win.

Gadson will have lane choice over Angie Smith in the next round.

Joey Gladstone leaves first 64% of the time. 

This is GT Tonglet’s first start since Las Vegas 2 in 2012.

This is the first time Gladstone and Tonglet have faced each other in eliminations. 

Tonglet gets out of the gate first but Gladstone reels him in quickly and pulls away for the win.

Oehler will have lane choice over Gladstone in the next round.

Matt Smith’s 204.61-mph qualifying run ranks as the third-fastest run in Pro Stock Motorcycle history. 

This is Malcolm Phillips Jr.’s 10th career start.

Smith is 1 - 0 against Phillips Jr. in prior events. 

Smith gets the holeshot and extends his lead all the way through the run.

Smith will have lane choice over Van Sant in the next round.

Gaige Herrera is 33–1 in Round 1 when he qualifies No. 1. 

This is the first time Arana Jr. has qualified No. 16.

Herrera is 6 - 1 against Arana Jr in prior events. 

Arana just misses the tree and goes red giving the win to Herrera.

Gaige Herrera's incremental times: 60ft-1.026 sec., 330ft-2.777, 660ft-4.257/165.06 mph, 1,000ft-5.557. 

Herrera will have lane choice over Johnson in the next round.
